title: WF03 f5 step04 rework2: ADM-UI fixture creation switched to UI flow to remove failing /api/v1/users dependency
summary: Resolved ADM-UI-03/04 fixture setup failures by replacing brittle API-request fixture creation with deterministic UI-based fixture creation aligned to the admin-users page flow used by the application.

root_cause.details: The E2E helper attempted backend fixture setup through a route contract that returns 404 in this environment. This made fixture setup fail before UI scenarios executed.

changes: Updated web/tests/e2e/f5-admin-users.e2e.spec.ts createUserFixture helper to create users through the UI flow and extract created id from routed URL.
Preserved cleanup logic with PATCH deactivate to avoid hard-delete contract assumptions.

prevention: Keep fixture setup paths aligned with tested UI contracts or route through app-level flows when backend admin fixture endpoints are not guaranteed.
Require at least one explicit assertion that fixture creation actually yields a persistent user id before continuing test steps.
